correctness.rationale: Affine GF(2) rectangle factorization has exactly a two-element representation kernel. The permutation equations force a shared difference bit, yielding 2^(cσ+cτ-1) for each admissible value; part exchange forces the composite permutation to flip a bit along each orbit and is feasible precisely for all-even cycles. Integer weight-pair Burnside yields both orbit counts. Direct independent matrix enumeration verified 288 group-character cases.
